Description:
Among sailors, this curious crustacean is jokingly likened to a Roegadyn's girthy fingers.

[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]
Name: First Mate's Finger

Description:
These moderately sized wavekin are so eerily pale as to be mistaken for water-bound spirits of the dead.

[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]
Name: Specterfish

Description:
These large saltwater fish are known to roam the endless expanse of the Indigo Deep.

[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]
Name: Rhotano Permit

Description:
This highly venomous species of anemone is native to the Rhotano Sea.

[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]
Name: Rhotano Dahlia

Description:
These slender wavekin have the dubious honor of being used as writing implements by those at sea bereft of actual pens.

[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]
Name: Lodesmate's Pen

Description:
Bright of scale and ferocious in temperament, this large saltwater specimen is a common sight between Thavnair and Eorzea.

[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]
Name: Rhotano Roosterfish

Description:
These vicious ancient scalekin have dominated the realm's oceans for millennia.

[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]
Name: Rhotanosaurus

Description:
Allegedly, this many-hued wavekin began its existence as an envoy's attendant who took an unfortunate plunge overboard.

[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]
Name: Royal Handmaiden

Description:
Exposure to spectral currents has endowed the flesh of this rare starfish with crystalline properties.

[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]
Name: Spectral Starfish

Description:
Given their name by island mammets, these colorful striped wavekin are just as playful as the appellation suggests.

[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]
Name: Frolicsome Fish

Description:
Ignoring their segmented carapace and plethora of other distinguishing features, these substantial crustaceans could, just about, be mistaken for a captain's missing digit.

[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]
Name: Captain's Finger

Description:
Bathing in the flows of spectral currents has dyed this coral a startling crimson.

[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]
Name: Bright Red Coral

Description:
Legends say this vibrantly patterned wavekin was once a royal attendant sadly swallowed up by the waves.

[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]
Name: Royal Favorite

Description:
These glittering wavekin are often mistaken for pouches of ill-gotten gold.

[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]
Name: Pirate's Purse

Description:
The observant will note that this slender cylindrical wavekin is roughly the same dimensions as a pen. The insatiably curious will seek to verify whether these poor fish can be used as one.

[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]
Name: Captain's Pen

Description:
Comparable to whales in terms of size, this colossal scalekin has endured since ancient times.

[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]
Name: Tylosaurus

Description:
These large saltwater fish are a common sight in the vicinity of the Cieldalaes, their distinctively spiny fins on full display.

[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]
Name: Cieldalaes Roosterfish

Description:
This exceptionally aggressive subspecies of rhotanosaurus is often seen riding spectral currents─its vast shadow inspiring awe and dread in equal measure.

[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]
Name: Renegade Rhotanosaurus

Description:
This resplendent red wavekin is no less brilliant than the spectral currents it plies.

[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]
Name: Red Boarfish

Description:
Hosting entire ecosystems on their expansive shells, these living islands are the subject of myriad folktales.

[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]
Name: Akupara

Description:
These nimble crustaceans are red. Unmistakably, undeniably, resoundingly red.

[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]
Name: Red Mantis

Description:
Prized for their sweet, scrumptious flesh, these crabs must be cooked before consumption, lest one wishes to ingest a bellyful of potent poison.

[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]
Name: Datli Gwl

Description:
Some believe these pale, tubular specimens to have once been strands of Saint Agama's stark white hair.

[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]
Name: Agama's Strand

Description:
Said to resemble the daggers favored by Thavnairian temple guards, these diminutive wavekin are revered as symbols of good fortune.

[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]
Name: Palaka's Blade

Description:
Along with dark clouds on the horizon and the sudden pitter-patter of raindrops, sightings of this species are often interpreted as a sign of impending precipitation.

[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]
Name: Parjanya Wrasse

Description:
This monstrous scalekin has a notably strong skull─one of many evolutionary advantages that include razor-sharp teeth and unparalleled bulk.

[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]
Name: Simolestes

Description:
Much loved by the local populace, these surprisingly gentle scalekin inhabit the waters around Thavnair.

[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]
Name: Thavnasaurus

Description:
This species of grouper is commonly sighted riding spectral currents. The aether it thus absorbs has transformed its flesh into a near-crystalline state.

[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]
Name: Spectral Grouper

Description:
Revered by inhabitants of fishing villages throughout Thavnair, the distinctive splotches that speckle this graceful wavekin make it easy to spot from a distance.

[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]
Name: Silkfin

Description:
These nimble crustaceans are redder than their lesser cousins. Unmistakably, undeniably, resoundingly redder.

[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]
Name: Great Red Mantis

Description:
A regular feature of banquets at the satrap's palace, these rare crabs are prized for their exquisite flavor.

[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]
Name: Guzel Gwl

Description:
Clad in scales so shiny as to be reflective, this wavekin's name means “mirror” in the common tongue.

[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]
Name: Darpana

Description:
The snouts of these aerodynamic wavekin are painfully sharp─so much so that they are occasionally used as darts when dried.

[Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]
Name: Silverdart

Description:
Understood to have persisted in Thavnair since ancient times, this scalekin is currently the subject of feverish Sharlayan scholarship.

[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]
Name: Satrapsaurus

Description:
Though its striped carapace evokes a sense of feline ferocity, these mantis shrimp are in actual fact almost hilariously timorous.

[Suitable for printing on small canvases.]
Name: Tiger Mantis

Description:
There are few creatures known to science that move with the same stubborn lack of urgency as the mehi-mahi.

[Suitable for printing on large canvases.]
Name: Mehi-mahi

Description:
Of countless species understood to ride spectral currents, this gargantuan scalekin must surely be counted among the largest and most dangerous.

[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]
Name: Pliosaurus

Description:
A prominent figure in Thavnairian mythology, this mighty tusked scalekin is said to ward off evil spirits.

[Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]
Name: Manasvin
